name: WW1 LECTURE FUN WITH JAMES FőZ
source:
Welcome to WW1 FUN! 

A educational(?)  game made for a school assessment.  Here you will learn about history with Professor Főz, whether you like it or not. 

[From [url=https://saturn-murray.itch.io/ww1-fun]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到一战乐趣！

为学校评估而制作的教育（？）游戏。在这里，无论你喜欢与否，你都将与Főz教授一起了解历史。

[来自[url=https://saturn-murray.itch.io/ww1-fun]Itch.io[/url]]
